confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to delete this object?
failedToReachBackend: Failed to reach backend on port
objectNameTooltip: Display name for the selected object.
lockedTooltip: Prevent editing the object in the scene.
objectUUIDTooltip: Immutable identifier for the object instance.
positionTooltip: Location of the object in meters.
scaleTooltip: Scale of the object along each axis.
rotationTooltip: Rotation of the object in degrees.
materialTypeTooltip: Choose a material supported by this renderable object.
baseboardEnabledTooltip: Show decorative trim along the bottom of the wall.
baseboardHeightTooltip: Height of the wall's bottom trim.
baseboardDepthTooltip: How far the bottom trim projects from each wall face.
baseboardColorTooltip: Color of the wall's bottom trim.
wallCreationDefaultsDescription: Configure how new walls, shared corners, and automatic floors are created in this space.
automaticFloorsTooltip: Create and maintain floor surfaces for closed wall loops.
wallConnectionShapeTooltip: Use a separate rectangular or circular geometry at every shared wall endpoint.
defaultWallHeightTooltip: Height assigned to newly drawn walls.
defaultWallColorTooltip: Color assigned to newly drawn walls.
defaultWallDecorationTooltip: Add a baseboard to newly drawn walls using the settings below.
openingWidthTooltip: Width of the door, window, or gate opening.
openingHeightTooltip: Height of the visible door, window, or gate panel. Gate wall cutouts always extend to the top of the wall.
openingThicknessTooltip: Thickness of the door, window, or gate panel.
openingAmountTooltip: Set 0 for closed, 100 for fully open, or an intermediate value for partially open.
openingEntityIdTooltip: Optional Home Assistant entity. Numeric states and current_position use 0-100; on/open means fully open and off/closed means closed.
doorOperationTypeTooltip: Choose a hinged or sliding door.
doorPanelCountTooltip: Choose a single door or a double door with two moving leaves.
doorHingeSideTooltip: Choose the left or right edge used to swing the door.
slideSideTooltip: Choose the side toward which a single panel slides.
doorOpeningDirectionTooltip: Choose which side of the wall the door swings toward.
doorKnobColorTooltip: Color of the door knob or handle.
gateOperationTypeTooltip: Choose a door-style swinging gate or a sliding gate.
gatePanelCountTooltip: Choose a single gate or a double gate with two moving leaves.
gateOpeningDirectionTooltip: Choose which side of the wall a door-style gate swings toward.
gateStyleTooltip: Choose a closed solid panel or an open panel made from vertical bars.
gateBarWidthTooltip: Width of the vertical bars and outer rails.
gateBarSpacingTooltip: Desired open space between adjacent vertical bars.
borderEnabledTooltip: Show decorative trim around the opening.
borderThicknessTooltip: Visible width of the trim around the opening.
borderDepthTooltip: How far the border projects beyond the opening.
doorWindowEnabledTooltip: Cut a glazed window into the door panel.
doorWindowWidthTooltip: Width of the glazed opening in the door.
doorWindowHeightTooltip: Height of the glazed opening in the door.
doorWindowPositionXTooltip: Window offset from the center of the door.
doorWindowPositionYTooltip: Height of the window center above the bottom of the door.
doorWindowBorderWidthTooltip: Width of the trim around the door window.
doorWindowColorTooltip: Tint of the door window glass.
doorWindowOpacityTooltip: Transparency of the door window glass from 0 to 1.
windowOpeningTypeTooltip: Choose whether the window slides or swings on hinges.
windowPanelCountTooltip: Choose one or two hinged sashes. Sliding windows always use two sashes.
windowSlidingPanelTooltip: Choose whether the left or right sash slides across the stationary sash.
openingDirectionTooltip: Choose which side of the wall a hinged window swings toward.
glassOpacityTooltip: Transparency of the glass from 0 to 1.
glassRoughnessTooltip: Surface roughness of the glass from 0 to 1.
windowGridEnabledTooltip: Add horizontal and vertical bars to split the glass.
windowGridHorizontalSpacingTooltip: Spacing between vertical bars; use zero for equal automatic spacing.
windowGridVerticalSpacingTooltip: Spacing between horizontal bars; use zero for equal automatic spacing.
windowBlindsEnabledTooltip: Add controllable horizontal blinds to the window.
windowBlindPlacementTooltip: Choose whether the blinds are mounted on the inside or outside face of the window.
windowBlindPositionTooltip: Set to 0 to raise the blinds or 100 to lower them fully.
windowShuttersEnabledTooltip: Add hinged louvered shutter doors to the outside of the window.
windowShutterPanelCountTooltip: Choose one full-width shutter door or two opposing doors.
windowShutterOpenAmountTooltip: Set 0 for closed across the window or 100 for fully open.
windowShutterBladeCountTooltip: Number of adjustable horizontal blades in each shutter door.
windowShutterBladeOpenAmountTooltip: Set 0 for closed blades or 100 for fully rotated open blades.
windowShutterColorTooltip: Color of the shutter frames and blades.
objectLocked: This object is locked and cannot be edited.
selectObjectPrompt: Select an object from the tree to edit its properties.
gridConfigurationDescription: Set the base grid extent and transform snap distance.
gridSizeTooltip: Base visible grid extent in meters. The grid expands automatically as the camera moves higher.
gridSnapSizeTooltip: Distance between snapped transform positions in meters.
createSpaceDescription: Create a separate 3D scene and make it active.
cloneSpaceDescription: Create a new copy of this space and all of its objects.
importSpaceChoiceDescription: Choose whether to create a new space with the archive's configuration or add only its objects to the current space.
spaceDefaultDescription: Open this space by default when the card does not specify another space. Selecting it clears the previous default.
confirmDeleteSpace: This permanently deletes the space and all objects inside it.
skyEnabledTooltip: Show the procedural daylight sky around the scene.
skyFollowDateTime: Follow Home Assistant date and time
skyFollowDateTimeTooltip: Use Home Assistant's current sun position so the sky follows the configured local daylight and night cycle. Manual sun angles are used if sun data is unavailable.
backgroundTypeTooltip: Choose what appears behind the scene when the sky is disabled: a solid color or the card background.
backgroundColorTooltip: Color shown when the sky is disabled and the solid background option is selected.
ambientColorTooltip: Base light color applied evenly across the scene.
ambientIntensityTooltip: Strength of the scene-wide ambient light.
sunlightColorTooltip: Color of the directional sun light.
sunlightIntensityTooltip: Strength of the directional sun light.
sunElevationTooltip: Vertical angle of the sun in degrees.
sunAzimuthTooltip: Horizontal direction of the sun in degrees.
floorplanCalibrationDescription: Select two points with a known real-world distance, then enter that distance in meters.
lightSourceTypeTooltip: Choose the light source used to illuminate the scene.
lightEnabledTooltip: Turn this static light on or off.
lightColorTooltip: Color emitted by the static light.
lightDistanceTooltip: Maximum illuminated distance. Set to 0 for no limit.
lightDecayTooltip: How quickly the light dims over distance.
lightCastsShadowsTooltip: Allow this light to cast shadows when shadow maps are enabled.
meshCastShadowsTooltip: Allow this mesh to cast shadows when shadow maps are enabled.
meshReceiveShadowsTooltip: Allow shadows from lights to appear on this mesh when shadow maps are enabled.
lightShadowBiasTooltip: Offset used to reduce shadow acne artifacts.
lightAngleTooltip: Maximum angle of the spot-light cone.
lightPenumbraTooltip: Softness around the edge of the spot-light cone, from 0 to 1.
lightWidthTooltip: Width of the rectangular emitting surface.
lightHeightTooltip: Height of the rectangular emitting surface.
defaultViewportTooltip: Open this space from this saved camera position.
hintMeasureDistance: Double-click on 2 points to measure distance
hintMeasureAngle: Double-click on 3 points to measure angle
hintMoveToPoint: Double-click anywhere in the scene to move the selected object. Press Escape to cancel.
hintWallEnd: Double-click to place the next wall point, or finish on an existing wall. Hold Ctrl to keep the segment on X or Z.
hintWallStart: Double-click to set the start point of the wall
hintWallEndpoints: Double-click a blue wall endpoint, then drag it to reshape the connected walls.
hintFloorStart: Double-click to set the first floor point
hintFloorContinue: Double-click to add floor points, then double-click the first point to close the shape. Hold Ctrl to keep the edge on X or Z.
hintAddDoor: Select a wall, then click to add a door
hintAddWindow: Select a wall, then click to add a window
hintAddGate: Select a wall, then click to add a gate
generalConfigurationDescription: Tone mapping, post-processing, and scene appearance settings.
defaultSpaceDescription: Space shown when the card opens. In view mode, this can only be changed in the card configuration.
cardViewportDescription: Saved camera position shown when the card opens. Leave this set to the space default to follow the viewport selected in the space editor.
navigationControlsDescription: Choose how pointer and keyboard input move the camera.
orientationCubeDescription: Show a 3D navigation cube. Double-click a face to align the camera to that view.
vrModeDescription: Show the VR button on devices that support immersive WebXR.
arModeDescription: Show the AR button on devices that support immersive WebXR. AR hides the sky and uses a transparent background.
arLocationBasedDescription: Anchor the center of this space to a Home Assistant entity with latitude and longitude attributes.
arLocationEntityDescription: Required for location-based AR. The entity's latitude, longitude, and optional altitude define the center of the space.
noLocationEntities: No entities with latitude and longitude found
arEnvironmentOrientationDescription: Clockwise bearing in degrees from geographic north for the front of the 3D environment.
visualizationOnlyDescription: Hide editing controls and object tree, while allowing navigation and object interaction.
hideOccludingWallsDescription: In visualization mode, hide up to two connected walls when a low camera angle would block the house interior.
entityClickActionDescription: Default action when an entity is clicked once.
entityDoubleClickActionDescription: Default action when an entity is double-clicked.
antialiasingTooltip: Smooth jagged geometry edges when the WebGL context is created.
toneMappingTooltip: Map high dynamic range lighting into the display color range.
resolutionTooltip: Render at a lower internal pixel ratio to improve performance.
shadowMapEnabledTooltip: Enable shadow-map rendering for lights and mesh objects.
shadowMapTypeTooltip: Choose the shadow filtering algorithm used by the WebGL renderer.
shadowMapQualityTooltip: Shadow resolution and filtering quality. Higher resolution shadows are more expensive to render.
lowPowerDeviceSettingsDescription: These overrides apply automatically on phones and tablets only.
disableShadowMapsTooltip: Turn off shadow-map rendering on phones and tablets.
reduceShadowMapQualityTooltip: Use low-resolution shadow maps on phones and tablets.
disablePostProcessingTooltip: Turn off all configured post-processing effects on phones and tablets.
disableAntialiasingTooltip: Create the mobile WebGL renderer without antialiasing.
bokehDepthTooltip: Blur geometry in front of and behind the current camera focus point.
bloomTooltip: Add a glow around the brightest parts of the scene.
gtaoTooltip: Enable high-quality ground-truth ambient occlusion. Enabling GTAO disables SSAO.
ssaoTooltip: Enable screen-space ambient occlusion. Enabling SSAO disables GTAO.
halftoneTooltip: Render the scene with a printed-dot halftone pattern.
filmGrainTooltip: Overlay animated film-like grain on the rendered scene.
focusDistanceTooltip: Distance from the camera to the depth-of-field focus plane.
apertureTooltip: Depth-of-field strength; larger values produce a shallower focused region.
maximumBlurTooltip: Maximum screen-space blur applied by the depth-of-field effect.
screenSpaceRadiusTooltip: Interpret GTAO radius in screen space instead of scene units.
developmentModeTooltip: Show the backend connection message and build timestamp.
geometryParameterTooltip: Rebuilds the mesh with this three.js geometry constructor parameter.
furnitureWidthTooltip: Overall left-to-right size of the furniture in meters.
furnitureDepthTooltip: Overall front-to-back size of the furniture in meters.
furnitureHeightTooltip: Overall height of the furniture in meters.
furnitureLegThicknessTooltip: Width and depth of each supporting leg.
furnitureLegInsetTooltip: Distance between the legs and the outer edge.
furnitureSeatHeightTooltip: Height of the sitting surface above the floor.
furnitureCushionThicknessTooltip: Thickness of the couch seat cushion.
furnitureRimThicknessTooltip: Width and height of the bathtub rim.
furnitureBoardThicknessTooltip: Thickness of the furniture panels and shelves.
furnitureShelfCountTooltip: Total number of horizontal shelf boards.
furnitureBackEnabledTooltip: Add a solid back panel to the shelf unit.
furnitureInteriorShelfCountTooltip: Number of adjustable shelves inside the cabinet.
furnitureHandleSizeTooltip: Vertical length of the cabinet door handles.
materialTextureTooltip: Choose an image file to apply as a new material texture.
materialTextureDrop: Drop an image or click to browse
clearMaterialTextureTooltip: Remove the current image texture from the material.
noEntityRules: No entity rules are associated with this object.
ruleTransformBaselineHint: The object's transform when the rule is created is used as the original value. Rotation values are in degrees.
ruleHideHint: The object is hidden while the entity has this state and shown again when it does not.
